sections.body: WEATHER is what happens day to day. CLIMATE is the usual pattern over many years.
Gases like carbon dioxide trap heat around the Earth like a blanket. This is the greenhouse effect, and it keeps Earth warm enough to live on.
Burning coal, oil and gas adds extra carbon dioxide, so the Earth is warming. Scientists agree this is mainly caused by human activity.
Solutions include clean energy (sun, wind, water), saving energy, protecting forests and wasting less.

quiz.q: What's the difference between weather and climate?
options: Weather is day to day; climate is the long-term pattern
hints: One is short-term, one is long-term.

quiz.explain: Weather is day-to-day; climate is the usual pattern over many years.
